reference.scope: visible face and hair appearance only

criteria.pass_requires: A held portrait photograph used to ask recognition, an open notebook used for recording, and an independently readable map used for a spatial answer, together in the scene.

The investigator's anatomical left hand visibly supports the photograph and anatomical right hand visibly grips the pen; trace each from its own shoulder through forearm. Screen placement alone is insufficient.
The gripped pen nib and notebook paper are both visible with an actual visible air gap; contact, uncertain overlap, occluded nib or cropped paper fails. Recording visibly pauses.

The attendant index fingertip visibly contacts the terminal pier landing on the map. The pier connects to a shoreline and projects into water; touch on shoreline, another branch or an unidentifiable patch fails.
The investigator's actual eye direction is toward that same contacted pier endpoint. Looking at the attendant face, portrait or notebook fails; head direction alone is partial evidence.
The ticket-booth inquiry is recognizable with empty boarding approach and harbor context consistent with the last departure.
Visible facial outline, large dark eyes, fine brows and soft lips plus dark chin-length bob and separated fringe remain consistent with the supplied appearance at the rendered scale.

strict_result: All criteria pass together; partial or unobservable evidence cannot pass a complete criterion.
